questions.question: In an election between two candidates, the winning candidate has got 70% of the votes polled and has won by 15400 votes. What is the number of votes polled for losing candidate?
questions.solution:
Let the voted poll be y

From the problems statement

⇒ 70 × y/100 - 30 × y/100 = 15400

⇒ y = (15400 × 100)/40

Votes polled for loosing party are (100 - 70)% of y

⇒ votes polled = (30 × 15400 × 100)/(100 × 40) = 11550

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of votes won by winning candidate = 70%

Percentage of votes obtained by losing candidate = 30%

Concept used:

Difference between the two = votes by which winning candidate won

**Calculation:**

40% = 15400

1% = 385

Then, votes got by losing candidate = 30% = 11550

**∴ The votes polled for losing party are 11550**

questions.question: A man gains 15% by selling a calculator for a certain price. If he sells it at the triple the price, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let the price at it he bought that calculator be Rs. Y

⇒ He sold it for = y × (1 + 15/100)

⇒ He sold it for = 1.15y

If he sells it for triple of this price

⇒ He sold it for Rs. 3 × 1.15y = 3.45y

Now the profit percentage can be given as

⇒ (3.45y - y) × 100/y

⇒ 245%

∴ Profit percentage will be 245%

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 6 days working 8 hours a day while B can do the same work in 4 days working 10 hours a day. If the work has to be completed in 5 days, so how many hours do they need to work together in a day?
questions.solution:
Work done by A in 1 day is 1/6 × 1/8 = 1/48th of the total work

Work done by B in 1 day is 1/4 × 1/10 = 1/40th of the total work

Let the number of hours needed to work for a day are y

From the problem’s statement

⇒ 5y(1/48 + 1/40) = 1

⇒ y = (40 × 48) / (88 × 5)

⇒ y = 48/11

Rightarrow y = 4 (4)/({11)}

∴ The number of hours required are 4 (4)/({11)} hours per day

questions.question: If a chord of a circle subtends an angle of 30° at the circumference of the circle, then what is the ratio of the radius of the circle and the length of the chord respectively?
questions.solution:
If a chord of a circle subtends an angle of 30° at the circumference of the circle then the angle subtended by chord at centre is 2 × 30° = 60°

In the triangle formed by cord at the centre One angle is 60° and other two are same because two sides opposite to that angles are same i.e. radius of circle

⇒ All the angles of triangle are 60° and hence it is equilateral triangle

∴ the ratio of radius and chord is 1 : 1

questions.question: Simple Interest received by a person in 10 years on a principal of Rs. 9500 is 130% of the principal. What is the rate of interest (in %) per annum?
questions.solution:
Let the rate be r%

Interest received can be given as

⇒ 130% of 9500

⇒ Interest = 130 × 9500/100 ----(i)

And simple interest can be written as

⇒ Simple Interest = (9500 × 10 × r)/100 ---- from equation (i)

⇒ (9500 × 10 × r)/100 = 130 × 9500/100

⇒ r = 13

∴ The rate is 13% per annum

questions.question: If (x + y + z) = 12, xy + yz + zx = 44 and xyz = 48, then what is the value of x³ + y³ + z³?
questions.solution:
Given x³ + y³ + z³ can be written as (x + y + z) {(x + y + z)² - 3(xy + yz + zx)} + 3xyz

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = (x + y + z) {(x + y + z)² - 3(xy + yz + zx) } + 3xyz

Using the given values

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = 12 × {(12)² - 3 × 44} + 3 × 48

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = 288

∴ x³ + y³ + z³ = 288

questions.question: A group of boys has an average weight of 36 kg. One boy weighing 42 kg leaves the group and another boy weighing 30 kg joins the group. If the average now becomes 35.7 kg, then how many boys are there in the group?
questions.solution:
Let the number of boys be y

Given that average initially is 36kg

⇒ (sum of age of all boys initially)/y = 36

⇒ 36y = sum of age of all boys initially ----(i)

Now when one boy joins and another leaves

⇒ (sum of age of boys initially - 42 + 30)/y = 35.7 Using (i)

⇒ 36y - 12 = 35.7y

⇒ 0.3y = 12

⇒ y = 40

∴ There are 40 boys in the group

questions.question: Three boxes of capacity 24 kg, 36 kg and 84 kg are completely filled with three varieties of wheat A, B and C respectively. All the three boxes were emptied and the three types of wheat were thoroughly mixed and the mixture was put back in the three boxes. How many kg of type A wheat would be there in the third box (in kg) ?
questions.solution:
In the mixture ratio of A : B : C is given as

⇒ 24 : 36 : 84

⇒ 2 : 3 : 7

Type A wheat in C can be founded as

⇒ (2 × 84)/(2 + 3 + 7)

⇒ 14

∴ 14 kg of wheat A is there in Box C

questions.question: If the square of sum of three positive consecutive natural numbers exceeds the sum of their squares by 292, then what is the largest of the three numbers?
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be a = (x - 1), b = (x) and c = (x + 1)

From the problem’s statement

(a + b + c) ² - (a² + b² + c²) = 292

⇒ a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca - a² - b²- c² = 292

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 146

⇒ (x) (x - 1) + (x) (x + 1) + (x + 1) (x - 1) = 146

⇒ 3x² = 147

⇒ x = 7

∴ The largest number is x + 1 = 8

questions.question: In a triangle PQR, ∠Q = 90°. If PQ = 12 cm and QR = 5 cm, then what is the radius (in cm) of the circumcircle of the triangle?
questions.solution:
We know that the circle circumscribing the right angled triangle is having hypotenuse of the triangle as its diameter

Radius of circle is ½ × hypotenuse

Now using Pythagoras theorem

⇒ hypotenuse² = 12² + 5²

⇒ hypotenuse = √169

⇒ hypotenuse = 13 cm

∴ Radius is 13/2 i.e. 6.5 cm
